historicalEvidence.policy: Preserve the historical PR125/126 provenance; this record describes the separate follow-up. Only missing spaces in the historical evidence text were corrected.

implementation: Operation-owned admission and tasks survive presentation supersession after admission; validated or confirmed actions replace pending edits.

Terminal edit dispositions retain admission history and distinguish not sent, succeeded, rejected and uncertain. Durable records retire; rejected server timestamps remain independently gated until newer data is observed.
Draft persistence uses one result-preserving serial queue; predecessor waits happen outside the FIFO presentation queue. Recovery flags follow enqueue acceptance and withdrawal.
Current authorization Retry settles once; stale Retry for a current owner preserves recovery. Window status carries owner-scoped waiting and saved-unsent feedback.

A Swift close coordinator protects document preflight, direct document close, window close, Close All and file-presenter deletion before teardown, while Objective-C lifecycle selectors and delegate ABI remain intact.
Keep Editing preserves recovery loading, replacement consent and admitted writes. Close warnings describe the current phase and available editor; persisted conflicts retain specific refresh guidance.

Manage Accounts stays accessible while account choices remain guarded. Preparation and teardown are simplified; the configuration-path cache includes the resolved home directory. Preferences synchronization is retained.
Reflog mutation workers retain their service after UI closure. Success reloads first-page events and references while preserving the success summary during loading.

Soft/mixed captures retain stat evidence. Hard captures additionally read affected and obstructing contents, including obstructing descendants and submodule paths. Index bytes, symlink, identity and nested-repository evidence remain protected.

Reset verifies target, checkout and predecessor evidence through ORIG_HEAD and the available HEAD reflog. Unsafe or unverified outcomes name expected and observed commits and the validated backup without automatic retry or rollback.
